scope: Benchmark expansion and qualification only; library production source unchanged from 735f809. Prior production correctness/fuzz/coverage evidence retains its original source scope. No new fuzz or coverage campaign claimed.

positive_gates.clippy: stable all timeline targets/features, warnings denied
positive_gates.msrv-smoke: Rust 1.85 executes all 640 profiles, 100 samples each; fixture assertions pass; not part of stable latency aggregates
positive_gates.timeline-tests: all-feature timeline tests, 1000 property cases per property seed 415
positive_gates.allocations: all 640 instrumented profile operations have zero allocations/reallocations/requested bytes
positive_gates.capacity: all 39 type-layout rows byte-identical to prior materialization archive

fixture_checks: Snapshot lookups and restores verify canonical/imported values for each width/layout/count. Outside timing, root/inherited materializations verify selected canonical descriptor and restored full state plus all 512 exact aliased input values. Timed materialization still verifies input_count, branch_count and branch high-water. Synthetic data does not prove arbitrary consumer state completeness or determinism.
limitations: Synthetic deterministic integer model, 512 u64 inputs and 65 snapshot slots. State lanes 1/128/512 mean 8 B/1 KiB/4 KiB; count means 1/8/32/63 initial canonical anchors, not replay length. Snapshot steps 0,8,...; child corrected at step 512. No game frame or universal library-overhead percentage.

Lookup/restore layouts cover root, inherited, child-local prefix and imported correction. Only root/inherited are materialized. Fixture creation, forks and full detached fixture verification are outside timing. Existing timed assertions remain. Caller replacement, superseded-store disposal, persistence and I/O excluded.

All 640 raw profile keys retained. Unchanged controls include unfavorable evicted read-all(8) 1613 to 2044 ns and scalar core_append(1) 40 to 50 ns. No fresh same-binary control; earlier controls retain their earlier source scope. No noninferiority claim.

Six latency runs completed before qualification builds/tests started. CPU affinity fixed; frequency, scheduling, caches, ASLR and unrelated host processes uncontrolled. Ranges and maximum run p99 are descriptive, not pooled percentiles or confidence intervals.

All 640 separately instrumented operations have zero Rust heap allocation/reallocation/requested bytes; arbitrary consumer clones and callbacks may allocate. The 39 capacity rows are unchanged. No new sampled-stack measurement or worst-case call-stack bound.

Production code is unchanged from optimized_production_revision; the baseline comparison isolates the prior materialization implementation while applying identical expanded benchmark code to both versions. This validates the existing optimization across state widths; it is not another production optimization.
